_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. The connector scans roots, skips the denylist (see denylist.js for the protective defaults), extracts text locally, and POSTs only text + provenance to GrantFlow.
_apiBaseUrl_note: Or set env LAPTOP_CONNECTOR_API. Use http://localhost:8080 against a local backend.
_roots_note: Owner asked for all of C: and G:. Narrow these if you want a faster, tighter scan. C:\ root works too but is slower.
_extraDenylist_note: Additional path segments to exclude, on top of the regulated + system defaults in denylist.js.
_dryRun_note: true = walk + list what WOULD be ingested, send nothing. Always do a dry run first.
